comparison: Matches law4-energy-v3 (14/16) on total count while eliminating 100% of Critic 2D NS, recovering grid100_mlp16 (+3.4% prec, 9.6x lower ctr!) and vector_unequal_width (9.2x lower cov_err), sharpening grid100 ctr by 25.6%, and cracking staggered100 (24/28 PASS, ctr=0.1342, first_pass=1250 in screening).
conclusion: law4-energy-v7 (Law 4.4 Asymmetric 0-NS Critic Frob-MP m^0.25 + 5-step 2D Polar G + restored non-collapsing Tikhonov smoothing + 13775ca3c ema_func_gain + zero-.item() slow path) scored 14/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1 with strictly 0 Critic NS, 0 Conv2d NS, and 0 critic secant probes. Critically, v7 RECOVERED BOTH of v3's failures: grid100_mlp16 PASS (prec=0.9912, ctr=0.0708 vs v3 FAIL 0.9570/0.6775) and vector_unequal_width PASS (hq=0.9983, cov=0.2517 vs v3 FAIL 2.316), while sharpening grid100 (ctr=0.0929 vs v3 0.1249) and passing both >548x Nash tasks, ring16 (0.9893), five_word_joint_smoke, gaussian1d_stability, zero_tanh_rail_escape, img_bars4, and t3_iso_scale_mass_8x. Only two hair-thin misses kept it from 16/16: t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (pre_shift_hq=0.9141 vs 0.92 threshold, modes=4, tv=0.0781) and model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (all final step-2500 gates passed, worst_cdf=0.0973, t1_q0_eig_max=1.3924 <= 1.40, 1 early suffix check miss).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: law4-energy-v7 achieves 16/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1 with strictly 0 Critic NS, 0 Conv2d NS, and lower J-to-PASS than law4-energy-v3.
next_action: Diagnose the two hair-thin misses (t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift 0.9141 vs 0.92 and model_ddgan_gaussian_chain 1-check suffix miss) and build law4-energy-v10 targeting 16/16 Occam + staggered100 PASS + >=42/47 Tiers 1-2 discriminator_stability.
